scenes.narration: Why does DeepSeek cost ten times less to run than other frontier models? The secret is Multi-Head Latent Attention.

props.title: DeepSeek's Secret: MLA
props.subtitle: How Multi-Head Latent Attention slashed KV-cache memory by 93%

scenes.narration: In standard transformers, storing Key-Value caches for thousands of tokens suffocates GPU memory. MLA compresses all Keys and Values into a single low-dimensional latent vector.

steps.title: Latent Compression
steps.desc: Project to tiny latent vector c_t

steps.title: On-the-Fly Decompression
steps.desc: Restore Q, K, V with zero cache bloat

scenes.narration: Compared to standard Multi-Head Attention and Grouped-Query Attention, MLA delivers a massive ninety-three percent reduction in KV cache memory while maintaining full expressiveness.

props.title: MHA vs DeepSeek MLA
leftPoints: Context length hits GPU VRAM walls

scenes.narration: Mathematically, the Key and Value states are compressed through a down-projection matrix, and decompressed during attention computation without ever caching the expanded states.

props.title: Low-Rank KV Compression
props.formula: c_t^{KV} = W^{DKV} h_t \quad \implies \quad k_t^C = W^{UK} c_t^{KV}
props.explanation: Only the compressed vector c_t is stored in memory, decompressing keys and values on the fly.

scenes.narration: Multi-Head Latent Attention proves that algorithmic efficiency beats brute-force compute. That is why DeepSeek is redefining open-weight AI.
